open_points.subject: check_value_forms
open_points.text: check_value_forms: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer one RefusalFailure, carrying the value's path, for every form value outside its form and none for the others, in the order of form_values, each value's form chosen by its field of = models.FormField: a value of the ALIAS member of = models.FormField longer than the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant counted in Unicode code points, one of the FLOOR_AREA member of = models.FormField for which _read_decimal_text answers None or whose Decimal is not greater than the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant, one of the ROOMS_COUNT member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None or whose integer is less than the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant, or one of the FLOOR member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None, is outside its form; one of the OBJECT_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.ObjectKind, one of the CUSTOMER_LANGUAGE member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerLanguage or one of the CUSTOMER_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerKind is outside its closed list; each failure's kind is the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member of = models.RefusalKind for a value outside its closed list and the OUTSIDE_FORM member of = models.RefusalKind for any other.
open_points.rule: Таблица — это когда по члену перечисления выбирается значение: член другого перечисления, код, категория.
open_points.question: The FormField-to-validation-category and RefusalKind correspondence must become an imported provider constant or rule table, and the note must name that imported constant instead of defining the correspondence inline.

open_points.subject: check_value_forms
open_points.text: check_value_forms: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show, at each bound and one step past it, that an alias of exactly the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant in Unicode code points passes and one code point more is refused, characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane counted as one; a number of rooms equal to the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant passes while one below it and one with a fraction are each refused; a floor area equal to the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant or below it is refused and a floor area above it passes, its Decimal kept exactly as written; a negative whole floor passes and a floor with a fraction is refused; an object kind outside = models.ObjectKind, a customer language outside = models.CustomerLanguage and a customer kind outside = models.CustomerKind are refused; each refusal's kind is the one the rule of the field gives, the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member of = models.RefusalKind for a closed list and the OUTSIDE_FORM member of = models.RefusalKind for any other form; several values outside their form are all answered together, each with its path.
open_points.rule: Такое соответствие — само значение, таблица соответствий, даже когда оно сводится к «один член — одно, остальные — другое»; подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list.
open_points.question: The test-evidence note must refer to the imported correspondence constant and require evidence that results follow it, rather than restating the closed-list-versus-other RefusalKind mapping inline.
